title: Alla battaglia (Isaac)
desc: Heinrich Isaac, Alla battaglia. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Isa3002); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
